title: Built track
description: The geometry half of a built track, from either a segment-DSL list or a {waypoints} spline descriptor (both share the same finalize step). Produced by the native TrackBuilder (native/libttp-track); the retired JS twin this was recorded from is in git history. All coordinates are world units, right-handed, +Y up. The centerline is a live class instance whose DATA shape is described here (see the `centerline` property); the host later AUGMENTS this object with game-side fields (cup, trackId, hazards, pads, boxes, poles, bananas, totalLaps, seed) that are a separate layer documented in docs/native-port/contract.md.

instances.description: Reserved for non-road scenery GLB placements. Always [] today (the road is a procedural ribbon).

startGate.description: Tell the renderer to build the procedural finish gantry straddling s = 0. A flag, not geometry.

baseY.description: Column base, sunk slightly below the grass plane.

topY.description: Column top, tucked just under the deck.

pillars.description: Vertical support columns under raised bridge/ramp (pillars: true) samples, spaced ~3.2 world units. Rendered as simple cylinders.

items.description: One berm run: a list of lofted cross-section rings, feathered to lawn level one ring past each end.

hills.description: Grass berm runs under raised, non-pillared road. The renderer stitches each run's rings into a grass surface.

s.description: Arclength of the loop MOUTH (the flat sample before the climb). World units.

width.description: Local road width at the mouth. World units.

loopStarts.description: Vertical-loop mouths. The host auto-places a full-width launch strip (a 'strip' pad) at each so a loop is always entered on boost.

contact.description: The flank road sample (plain objects) whose underside plane the renderer clips the shaft top to.

supportPosts.description: Loop-brace shafts: one vertical post per lower-outer flank of each 360-degree loop. Shafts that cannot clear every drivable corridor are dropped.

s.description: Arclength of the crossing's closest-abeam sample. World units.

lat.description: Signed lateral offset; positive = right of travel.

ghost.description: The renderer must NOT draw this pole: the pillar/shaft it proxies is already the visual.

autoPoles.description: Engine collision poles for any pillar/support shaft standing >= 0.25 deep in a drivable corridor, one per contiguous road crossing. The host concatenates these into the augmented track's `poles` for the engine and AI.

samples.description: Closed polyline of oriented frames, uniform ~0.5 world-unit arclength spacing, parallel-transported with banking applied and seam holonomy unwound.

length.description: Same value as the track's top-level `length`.

centerline.description: The centerline (native/libttp-track/ttp/centerline.h); this schema describes its serializable DATA, which is what crosses the ABI. A port must also reproduce its methods, pinned numerically by the golden traces: sampleAt(s) (fresh frame {pos, tangent, up, lateral, width}; s wraps mod length; non-uniform Catmull-Rom position with the spline's own derivative as tangent; up lerped + renormalized; lateral = tangent x up), projectNear(point, sHint, maxStep) (Newton projection onto the local strand returning {s, lat, frame} with s accumulated and NOT wrapped, hard-clamped to sHint +- maxStep), and widthAt(s).

length.description: Total closed-lap arclength, world units, including the last-to-first wrap span. Shipped tracks: ~350-480.

closed.description: The segment walk returned to the start (unscaled end gap < 0.5). Spline tracks close by construction.

gap.description: UNSCALED distance from the last emitted point to the start, measured before scaling. The closure check's raw input.

roadWidth.description: The track's DEFAULT drivable width, world units (unscaled width x SCALE = 2; standard 5.0). Per-sample width may flare/pinch; the engine seeds its lateral clamp from this but the live curb clamp uses the per-sample width.

groundY.description: Grass plane elevation: just under the lowest road EDGE (min(minY - 0.3, minEdgeY - 0.12)), so banked kerbs cannot clip the lawn.

vec3.description: 3D vector. Plain {x, y, z} data shape; Vec3 instances in the live object.

lateral.description: Unit lateral = tangent x up; points to the driver's RIGHT.

s.description: Cumulative arclength from the start line (samples[0].s = 0). World units.

width.description: Local drivable width, world units (can differ from the track default).

pillars.description: This sample belongs to a bridge/ramp stretch that grows support pillars.

hillable.description: This sample may grow a grass berm beneath it (open-ground rise, not a stunt/bridge).

topL.description: Left top-corner height, following the road's bank, clamped to groundY.

topR.description: Right top-corner height, following the road's bank, clamped to groundY.

hillRing.description: One lofted berm cross-section: left foot -> left top -> right top -> right foot, feet at groundY.
